title: Block Hours of a Project Time Group — TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours
content:
This calculation applies to project time of a client holding exactly one live time-and-materials engagement on Professional Services Projects, a group being the TimeBank-routed lines of that statement of work for one date and level.

**When groups are drawn.** Project time of a work date is logged in full at the close of that date, before any of that date's groups is drawn and before any line of a later date is drawn, so a group is drawn once, for all its lines, and no earlier date is left waiting; no line is logged for a date after that date's groups are drawn.

**Which group.** Project groups are drawn one at a time from the client's most recently dated block-routed project time: the group figured is the first group not yet drawn taking levels in the order architect, senior engineer, technician; all block-routed time is on the one statement of work, so the date and level name the group and that order ends every tie. The group is drawn on its statement of work and level. A group counts as drawn when the block's ledger carries a project-work draw recording its statement of work, date and level; when the client has no block-routed project time, or every group of that date is drawn, no project group is figured.

**Block hours.** A project group on TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours draws its summed logged minutes, business-hours and after-hours lines together, divided by 60, at the size's technician ratio and with a multiplier of 1, rounded half up to the hundredth of an hour once, at the end.

## Worked case (hypothetical date with three groups, none drawn)

| Group | Logged lines | Summed minutes | Block hours | Order figured |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| architect | 90 and 45 | 135 | 2.25 | first |
| senior engineer | 200 | 200 | 3.33 | second |
| technician | 30, 30 and 15 | 75 | 1.25 | third |

Once the architect group's draw is on the ledger, the senior engineer group is the group figured; once all three are drawn, nothing is figured for that date.
